title: Patient Portal Terms for Appointment Series Bookings and Cancellations
content:
These terms set out which Appointment Series formats a patient may book and cancel through the Piedmont Motion patient portal, and how close to the appointment start the portal still accepts the request.

## 1. Portal access by format

| Visit format | Portal booking | Portal stops booking an appointment (hours before its start) | Portal cancellation | Portal stops accepting a cancellation (hours before the start) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | Allowed | 2 | Allowed | 2 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | Allowed | 2 | Allowed | 2 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | Allowed | 2 | Allowed | 2 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | Allowed | 24 | Allowed | 24 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | Not allowed | 0 | Not allowed | 0 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | Allowed | 2 | Allowed | 2 |

## 2. Meaning of the cutoffs

2.1 The booking cutoff is the number of hours before the appointment start after which the portal no longer books that appointment. It is 0 for a format whose appointments the portal does not book at all.

2.2 The cancellation cutoff is the number of hours before the appointment start after which the portal no longer accepts a cancellation of it. It is 0 for a format whose appointments cannot be cancelled through the portal.

## 3. Illustrations (hypothetical times)

- An Aquatic Therapy Visit Series appointment starts at 09:00 on a Thursday. The portal books it, or accepts its cancellation, up to 09:00 on the Wednesday, 24 hours before the start; once that moment has passed, the portal no longer books or cancels it.
- A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series appointment starting at 16:00 can still be booked or cancelled in the portal at 14:00 the same day, 2 hours before the start, and no longer once that point has passed.
- A Specialty One-on-One Visit Series appointment is never booked or cancelled through the portal, whatever the notice.
